Napoleon.exe imports exactly Direct3DCreate9, D3DPERF_BeginEvent and D3DPERF_EndEvent from d3d9.dll; the proxy exports all three (proxy/core/d3d9.def)
Napoleon.exe (Steam) is sha1 9aebcd2172f2878d781b079f7feb45b0e12e0250, 17,895,424 bytes, PE TimeDateStamp 0x645e917f, SizeOfImage 0x014eb000, ImageBase 0x400000
Napoleon.exe is 32-bit x86, large-address-aware, ASLR (dynamic base with a .reloc table: every static address is rebased) and NX

claim: Napoleon.exe loaded at 0x00610000 in all four launches with the proxy on 2026-10-28 (ASLR per boot): never assume 0x00400000

The Windows loader rewrites OptionalHeader.ImageBase in Napoleon.exe's MAPPED header to the actual load base; the preferred base 0x00400000 survives only in the file, so a rebase delta must come from the file header
notes: seen as 'preferred 0x00610000, delta 0' in build 690ec1a logs; fixed in 526e1c9 (pe.h LoadDelta), host-tested only, not yet re-run on the PC
